I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message. I told him I'll treat Bay 15 as unverified.

I couldn't find anything that confirms the Jasper rollout site at Marrow Fieldworks. I checked the workspace brain and what Tobias can see himself: the Central channels and the public files. The only bay numbers that came up were for other things, like the Bay 4 ticket at the Salina North yard.

I asked him to post in the same thread if he gets it confirmed or learns who said it. Nothing was recorded as fact.
